title: StableVC: Style Controllable Zero-Shot Voice Conversion with Conditional Flow Matching
tldr_zh: 解耦内容/音色/风格，OT-CFM 重建 mel，音色与风格可独立迁移到不同 unseen 说话人，10 步采样 RTF 0.146
tldr_en: Disentangles content/timbre/style and uses OT-CFM to independently transfer timbre and style to different unseen speakers, 10-step sampling RTF 0.146

key_numbers.number: WER 2.03, SECS 0.67, UTMOS 4.12, nMOS 3.96, sMOS-p 4.04, RTF 0.146, 166M params
RTF 0.146 vs LM-VC 3.891 (≈25.3× speedup claimed), vs DDDM-VC 0.287 (≈1.65× speedup claimed)
Style transfer: Corr 0.75, RMSE 12.87, WER 2.12, SECS 0.64
10 Euler steps: UTMOS 4.12, WER 2.03, SECS 0.67; 5 steps: UTMOS 3.82, WER 2.98, SECS 0.61
w/o timbre prior & multi-ref: WER 22.16 (vs 2.12 full); w/o adaptive gate: SECS 0.36 (vs 0.64)
Training: 20k hours LibriLight subset, 8×3090 GPUs, 800K iterations, batch 128, lr 0.0001
K-means clusters 1024 for WavLM content tokens; GRL loss weight λ=0.1
